name: Screenpipe
description: Search locally captured screen and audio history through MCP, CLI or API for recall and work summaries. Configured cloud services can transmit context.

skills.name: Continuous Screen Capture
skills.description: Capture screen text and audio history locally by default; optional cloud transcription can send audio to a provider.

skills.name: Searchable History
skills.description: Search captured screen text and audio transcripts by text, app or time window to find past conversations and work.

skills.name: Agent Context Feed
skills.description: Provide recorded work context to Claude, Codex and other connected agents through MCP or the local API.

content.value: Run the Screenpipe recorder locally. Connect through Settings > Connections in the desktop app, which supplies SCREENPIPE_LOCAL_API_KEY. For manual MCP setup, use your own key from screenpipe auth token. See the official MCP documentation linked above.

Screenpipe captures searchable screen text and audio history locally by default for recall, meeting notes and work summaries. Configured cloud AI, transcription, sync and integrations can transmit context off-device. The source is available under the Screenpipe Commercial License, not an OSI open-source license. Current plans: https://screenpipe.com/pricing.
